description.text: Program Emphasis Automobile Marketing, Automobile Insurance, Automobile Assessment Main Courses Mechanical drawing, Electronic Technology,Theoretical mechanics, Material, Engine Mechanics, Car infrastructure, Automobile theory, Automobile electrical equipment, Automobile Application Engineering, Automobile Marketing, Automobile Maintenance Engineering, Automobile insurance and Claims Settlement, Vehicle Assessment and Evaluation. Duration 4 years Degree Awarded With necessary credits, those who have passed all the required courses and met the requirements for graduation of the university will be awardedbachelor's degree and diploma. Career Opportunity Graduates will be capable to work in management team within big companies , organizations and institutions specialized in automobile marketing , automobile Insurance , automobile assessment and maintenance Notes: Program commences only if 15 students are enrolled ; otherwise you can study Chinese Language/ Pre- University Program/ other bachelor programs.

duration.text: The Automobile Service at Shandong Jiaotong University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3444 USD/per year ￥ 24800 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3. High school's degree certificate Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2. High school graduate or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate 3. Be in good health condition and above the age of 18
